items.summary: On 2026-10-29 Innolight (300308.SZ) said its board approved changing the purpose of 5.6531 million A-shares held in the repurchase account from an employee stock ownership or equity incentive plan to cancellation and registered-capital reduction.
items.summary_zh: 10月29日， 中际旭创 (300308.SZ)公告称，公司董事会审议通过议案，拟将回购专用证券账户中持有的565.31万股A股股份用途由“实施员工持股计划或 股权激励 计划”变更为“用于注销并减少注册资本”
